get.summary: Search stores by name or fuzzy query
get.description:
Allows drivers to search for stores associated with their booth. 
If `q` (query) is empty, returns all stores.
Supports two search modes:
1. **name**: exact substring match
2. **fuzzy**: fuzzy text matching with adjustable threshold.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: Fuzzy search threshold (0 to 1). Lower values allow looser matches. Only applies when `search_type=fuzzy`

200.description: A list of stores matching the search query

400.description: Invalid parameters (e.g., missing query, invalid search_type, or invalid threshold)

get.summary: Retrieve sessions (single active or filtered list)
get.description:
Retrieve parking session(s) based on query parameters for an authenticated user (DRIVER, STORE, or CUSTOMER). Drivers can access all sessions associated with their booth.  
- If `vehicle_license_number` is provided, returns the active session for that vehicle.
- Otherwise, returns a filtered list of sessions (using `vehicle_number_query`, date range, status, etc.)
- If no filters are provided, all sessions are returned (paginated).

parameters.name: vehicle_license_number
parameters.description: Retrieve the active session for this exact vehicle license number

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of vehicles to return in a single response. Default is 40

parameters.name: last_evaluated_key
parameters.description: A JSON string representing the last evaluated key for pagination. Use this value to retrieve the next page of results.

parameters.name: vehicle_number_query
parameters.description: Substring of the vehicle license number to filter sessions. Will return sessions matching any vehicle license number containing this substring.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start date/time for filtering sessions

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End date/time for filtering sessions

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Sort by entry or exit time. If no sessions are found with status="PICK_UP_REQUESTED", sessions are sorted by entry_time.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Parking statuses to filter (OR condition). You can pass multiple values like`?status=PARKING_REQUESTED&status=PICK_UP_REQUESTED`. If not provided, all states are returned.

parameters.name: payment_state
parameters.description: Payment states to filter (OR condition). You can pass multiple values like `?payment_state=REQUESTED&payment_state=PAID`. If not provided, all states are returned.

message.example: An active Smart Ticket session exists for this vehicle

put.description:
Update the parking state of a session.
When status is "PICK_UP_REQUEST_ACCEPTED", handover_eta_minutes must be provided.
"HANDED_OVER" and "HANDED_OVER_EXCEPTION" can be transitioned to from any state. This supports the case where a customer arrives at the parking lot to collect their vehicle before a PICK_UP_REQUESTED has been made, in which case the payment is finalized at the time of handover.
Special rules apply when the status is "CANCELLED":
1. Only drivers can cancel.
2. Customer verification via QR code (`customer_id`) or Smart Ticket (`ticket_number`) is required.
3. Cancellation must be within 5 minutes of session creation.

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: The ID of the session to update

status.description: New parking state for the session

ticket_number.description: Smart ticket number for verification (required only if cancelling)

handover_eta_minutes.description: ETA (in minutes) of vehicle that is set by the driver.  Required only when status = PICK_UP_REQUEST_ACCEPTED.   Backend will convert this into an absolute datetime.

location.description: Current location of the vehicle at session transition.  Required for PARKING_REQUESTED, PARKING_IN_PROGRESS, PARKED, PULL_OUT_IN_PROGRESS, READY_FOR_HANDOVER, READY_FOR_HANDOVER, HANDED_OVER, HANDED_OVER_EXCEPTION, PULL_OUT_RETURNING

status.description: Updated parking status of the session

handover_eta.description: Calculated ETA. Returned for PICK_UP_REQUEST_ACCEPTED and any subsequent states (READY_FOR_HANDOVER, HANDED_OVER, HANDED_OVER_EXCEPTION) if previously set.

updated_at.description: Time the parking status of the session was updated

This endpoint verifies the payment with Toss, marks the payment as PAID,

(card, virtual account, easy pay).

updated_at.description: When the session was last updated

parking_duration_min.description: Total parking duration in minutes from PARKING_REQUESTED to the current calculation point.

base_unit_min.description: The initial number of minutes included in the base parking fee as defined by the booth pricing.

base_amount.description: Fee charged for the base_unit_min. This is the booth fixed starting fee for parking.

extra_price_per_unit.description: Fee applied for each additional unit of time beyond the base_unit_min, as defined by the booth pricing.

extra_unit_min.description: The number of minutes that defines one additional billing unit for calculating extra fees.

extra_fee.description: Total additional fee calculated for the time exceeding the base_unit_min, using extra_unit_min and extra_price_per_unit.

total_estimated_fee.description: Sum of base_amount, extra_fee, and any applicable penalties; represents the total estimated parking fee at this calculation point.

penalty_amount.description: Added penalty fee for a RETURNED session as defined by booth pricing

is_finalized.description: Whether the parking fee has been finalized or not. True when the session has reached PICK_UP_REQUESTED state, or when HANDED_OVER/HANDED_OVER_EXCEPTION is reached without a prior PICK_UP_REQUESTED.

calculated_at.description: Timestamp at which the fee was calculated

accepted.description: Indicates whether a consent has been accepted

required.description: Indicates whether a consent is required

consents_updated_at.description: Time the consents were updated at

is_deleted.description: Indicates whether the notification has been deleted
